abstract: Pancreatic cancer is characterized by a dense desmoplastic stroma and a profoundly immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME), which jointly impede drug penetration and immune activation. Here, we report a microenvironment-responsive injectable marine polysaccharide hydrogel (G@ZnFe-Gel) empowered by a Zn/Fe bimetallic MOF nanozyme to achieve in situ pancreatic cancer immunotherapy via ferroptosis-cGAS-STING synergy. Following intratumoral injection, the hydrogel undergoes rapid thermally and Ca2+-reinforced gelation, forming a stable intratumoral depot that ensures prolonged local retention within stromal-dense pancreatic tumors. Mechanistically, glucose oxidase (GOD)-mediated glucose oxidation disrupts tumor metabolism while generating H2O2, which is further converted into highly reactive oxygen species through Fe3+-mediated Fenton-like reactions, inducing lipid peroxidation and ferroptosis. Comparisons with the Zn-Gel control further support the additional contributions of Fe incorporation and GOD loading to the enhanced ferroptosis-associated responses. In addition, ferroptosis-associated mitochondrial stress and potential DAMP release, including mtDNA, may contribute to enhanced cGAS-STING signaling, with a possible additional contribution from Zn2+ signaling. In a subcutaneous pancreatic cancer model, G@ZnFe-Gel markedly suppressed tumor growth, promotes macrophage reprogramming, enhanced cytotoxic T-cell infiltration, and remodeled the immunosuppressive TME without systemic toxicity. This work establishes a mechanism-driven hydrogel-nanozyme platform that integrates local retention, regulated cell death, and innate-adaptive immune crosstalk, offering a promising strategy for immunologically cold and stroma-rich solid tumors.
key_points_ko: G@ZnFe-Gel은 췌장암 모델에서 전신 독성 없이 종양 성장을 현저히 억제했습니다.
철화사멸 유도 및 cGAS-STING 신호 활성화를 통해 면역억제성 종양 미세환경을 재조형했습니다.
세포독성 T세포 침투를 증가시키고 대식세포 재프로그래밍을 촉진했습니다.
summary_ko: 이 연구는 촘촘한 기질과 면역억제성 종양 미세환경을 가진 췌장암을 국소 치료하기 위해 미세환경 반응성 주사형 해양 다당류 하이드로겔(G@ZnFe-Gel)을 개발했습니다. 이 하이드로겔은 Zn/Fe 이금속 금속-유기 골격체(MOF) 나노효소를 탑재하여 철화사멸(ferroptosis)과 cGAS-STING 신호전달 경로를 동시에 활성화하도록 설계되었습니다. 피하 췌장암 동물 모델에서 G@ZnFe-Gel은 전신 독성 없이 종양 성장을 현저히 억제하고, 대식세포 재프로그래밍을 촉진하며, 세포독성 T세포 침투를 증가시켰습니다. 초록에 명시되지 않음
title: Microenvironment-responsive injectable marine polysaccharide hydrogel empowered by bimetallic MOF nanozymes for in situ pancreatic cancer immunotherapy via ferroptosis-mediated cGAS-STING activation
title_ko: 미세환경 반응성 해양 다당류 하이드로겔과 이금속 MOF 나노효소를 이용한 철화사멸 매개 cGAS-STING 활성화 기반 췌장암 면역치료
